events.title: Consulting Business Conference 2026
events.venue: Lagos Marriott Hotel, Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria
events.speaker: Kelechi Uzoma Obijiaku
events.focus: How consultants can identify, access and compete for public sector consulting opportunities.
events.description: Government needs expertise. How can your consulting business get through the door? Join Kelechi Uzoma Obijiaku for a practical look at identifying public sector opportunities, understanding procurement requirements and competing with confidence. Designed for consultants, consulting firms, entrepreneurs and professionals ready to turn their expertise into credible government contracting opportunities.
takeaways: Recognise where your expertise meets public sector consulting needs.
Understand the procurement requirements that shape access to government contracts.
Prepare to compete with a clearer view of opportunities, eligibility and client expectations.
